'''Ribuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Ribuk was born on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and became a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he competed in the [[Cularin Classic]] race, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Ribuk was very competitive and would do everything possible to try and win races. He was willing to "bump" the [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] of other competitors if he believed it would give him and advantage in a race.
